{{Quote|I can't claim to know the will of the Force: I only know that there must be a good reason for Syl to have been returned to us.|Satele Shan|<ref name="Trad">{{TORcite|type=message|An update.|Satele Shan}}</ref>}}
'''Syl''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. Syl was one of [[Satele Shan]]'s [[Satele Shan's followers|students]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. Shan and her students, including Syl, were all infected by [[Tenebrae]]'s [[Tenebrae's curse|curse]] and held within a massive [[Kira Carsen's ship|ship]] by [[Kira Carsen]] and [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]]. However, they were [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|released]] by the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] who ended Tenebrae for good.<ref name="Echoes" /> Syl was thought to be [[Death/Legends|dead]] but miraculously survived the ordeal.<ref name="Trad" />

==Biography==
===Follower of Shan===
Syl was one of many Force users who became part of a crop of students that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Satele Shan]] started to train at a secret [[Jedi academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the [[war against Zakuul]].<ref name="State">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20181130|text=Jedi Under Siege: State of the Galaxy}}</ref>

===Tenebrae's curse===
{{Quote|While we mourned the loss of Trad, we discovered that Syl was, in fact, still alive.|Satele Shan|<ref name="Trad" />}}
[[File:Syl_seemingly_dead_inside_the_mindscape.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Syl seemingly dead on Satele Shan's [[mindscape]]]]
When Satele Shan unknowingly became infected by the plague of the deceased Emperor [[Tenebrae]], Syl and the rest of the followers also became infected. They were all left in a nightmarish sleep before slowly merging into a hive mind. [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kira Carsen]] kept them quarantined in the [[Kira Carsen's ship|latter's ship]], flying an undetermined course through unsettled sectors of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Echoes" />

After most of the followers were [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|released]] from the curse by the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]], who ended Tenebrae for good, Syl was believed to be dead like fellow student [[Trad]], but in reality she miraculously survived the infection.<ref name="Trad" />

===Return of the Ex-Jedi===
{{Quote|Satele, Sal-Deron asked to see you. When you can spare a moment.|Syl to Satele Shan|<ref name="Quite">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210413|text="Quite A Story To Tell"|int=Quite A Story To Tell}}</ref>}}
[[File:Syl_sees_Satele_Shan_and_Aryn_Leneer_reunite.jpg|thumb|250px|Syl sees Aryn Leneer.]]
Back on Coruscant after the incident with Tenebrae, Syl watched how the former Jedi [[Aryn Leneer]] went to meet with Master Satele Shan.<ref name="Echoes" /> The young student later interrupted their conversation by telling Satele that Master [[Sal-Deron]] wanted to speak with her, if she could spare the time, barely glancing at Aryn before she left the room. Both Satele and Aryn briefly talked about Syl after she left before meeting Sal-Deron.<ref name="Quite" />

==Personality and traits==
A young Human female with bright red hair, Syl was described by Satele Shan as a complicated student with whom she has to pick her battles wisely. Syl seemed to be very informal, as she addressed her master simply as Satele, which surprised Aryn Leneer.<ref name="Quite" />

==Behind the scenes==
Syl first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' as part of the "Echos of Oblivion" flashpoint, where the student's name was first revealed by Kira Carsen.<ref name="Echoes" />
